summary.en: Read and write Feishu / Lark as the signed-in person, not as a bot, through an openlark-gateway you run yourself.
summary.zh-CN: 通过你自己运行的 openlark-gateway，以登录者本人而不是机器人的身份读写飞书。

hint.en: wss://… or https://…; ws:// and http:// only for a gateway on this machine
hint.zh-CN: wss://… 或 https://…；ws:// 和 http:// 只用于本机上的网关

hint.en: Create with `openlark-gateway cred create`. Credential scopes grant methods; the gateway's `[safety] writes` sets target restrictions (`open` removes them). Steve Hub permissions are separate.
hint.zh-CN: 用 `openlark-gateway cred create` 创建。凭据的 scope 决定可调用的方法；网关的 `[safety] writes` 决定可写的目标（`open` 解除目标限制）。Steve Hub 权限单独管理。
